meta.name: linkedin-ads-creative
meta.description: Design LinkedIn Ads creative strategy including format selection, visual best practices, Thought Leader Ads, and refresh cadence. Use when the user asks about LinkedIn ad formats, image specs, video ads, carousel ads, Thought Leader Ads, Document Ads, creative refresh, ad fatigue, or which LinkedIn ad format to use. Triggers on "LinkedIn ad format", "Thought Leader Ads", "TLA", "Document Ads", "carousel ads", "video ads", "image specs", "creative refresh", "ad fatigue", "LinkedIn ad creative". Do NOT use for ad copy/text (use copy) or bidding (use bidding).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计 LinkedIn 广告创意策略，提升投放效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为 LinkedIn 广告选择格式并制定创意更新计划
copy.tagline_en: Design LinkedIn ad creative strategy to improve campaign performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to choose LinkedIn ad formats and plan creative refresh

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会帮你设计LinkedIn广告创意策略，包括选择合适格式、应用视觉最佳实践、规划每4-6周刷新，并针对Thought Leader Ads推荐有机CTR在2-3%的帖子。
howto.when: 当你询问LinkedIn广告格式、图片规格、视频广告、轮播广告、Thought Leader Ads、文档广告、创意刷新或广告疲劳时触发。

say.text: 我应该用哪种LinkedIn广告格式？
say.note: Claude会询问目标及漏斗阶段，匹配格式。
Claude会解释TLA策略并推荐内容类型。

say.text: 我的广告创意需要刷新吗？
say.note: Claude会检查CTR和频率，给出刷新建议。

howto.what_en: Claude helps design LinkedIn ad creative strategy: matching format to funnel stage, applying visual best practices (non-ad-like, square, moving elements), planning refresh every 4-6 weeks, and selecting Thought Leader Ads with 2-3% organic CTR.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about LinkedIn ad formats, image specs, video ads, carousel ads, Thought Leader Ads, Document Ads, creative refresh, or ad fatigue.

say_en.text: Which LinkedIn ad format should I use?
say_en.note: Claude asks your objective and funnel stage to match format.

say_en.text: How do I use Thought Leader Ads?
say_en.note: Claude explains TLA mechanics and recommends content types.

say_en.text: Should I refresh my ad creative?
say_en.note: Claude checks CTR and frequency, suggests refresh if needed.
